/messages.businessPurpose: COMMS inbox for direct/club/community conversations (Messaging Experience)
/messages.targetUsers: Authenticated messaging users (players/members/staff via COMMS runtime)
/messages.roles: V5 menu leaf has no explicit roles; with RBAC on leaf filtered (empty perms, not public menu path). Canonical: excluded by B01.
/messages.tenantBehavior: Production gateway tenant/club-aware for club/community; direct messaging actor-scoped
/messages.dataSource: COMMS runtime gateway; intended communication_* schema; demo/in-memory when DEMO
/messages.searchEntry: Excluded from canonical search; present in legacy GlobalSearch via MENU_GROUPS when flag OFF
/messages.breadcrumbs: No page-local; canonical cannot resolve registry node
/messages.deepLinkBehavior: /messages opens inbox; no thread id route param
/messages.queryStringBehavior: None consumed; runtime ignores QS for demo enablement

/crm/messages.businessPurpose: Club-scoped CRM outreach compatibility shell: draft/send-local SMS/Zalo/email records + contact history (does not deliver externally)
/crm/messages.roles: V5 CRM group (excludes REFEREE/PLAYER). Canonical Level-1 10 with booking.view|customer.view
/crm/messages.tenantBehavior: Keyed by active clubId localStorage blob; missing/demo club fail-closed; hard cutover blocks writes
/crm/messages.dataSource: localStorage pickleball-crm-messages-v1::{clubId} and contact-history keys — no Supabase
messageTypes: CRM local draft|sent records; channels sms|zalo|email
/crm/messages.navigationEntry: V5 CRM menu; canonical menu/search; AI in-page nav
/crm/messages.breadcrumbs: Canonical registry trail under Thông báo / CRM
/crm/messages.deepLinkBehavior: /crm/messages opens page; no message-id deep link

ownerDecisions.plainLanguageQuestion: Should Communication inbox (/messages) and CRM outreach (/crm/messages) stay as two separate business functions, or be collapsed?
ownerDecisions.recommendedLabel: Keep both as separate canonical business functions

rejectedOptions.label: Make /messages an alias of /crm/messages
rejectedOptions.reason: Functional and RBAC equivalence NOT proven

rejectedOptions.label: Retire one function and migrate its capability in Phase 4
rejectedOptions.reason: CRM retirement needs a durable CRM migration program outside Phase 4 nav cutover; retiring COMMS would destroy certified messaging

ownerDecisions.consequence: Revise Phase 1 B01: do NOT redirect /messages→/crm/messages. Restore /messages as canonical Communication route in registry/menu/search (with proper COMMS auth). Keep /crm/messages as canonical CRM outreach.
ownerDecisions.risk: Canonical registry currently treats CRM as sole messaging owner; revising B01 requires registry + menu updates and clear labels so users do not confuse inbox vs outreach.
ownerDecisions.implementationImpact: No alias redirect. Update ownerDecisions/catalog/menu/search; add COMMS route permissions if missing; keep both pages mounted.

ownerDecisions.plainLanguageQuestion: Approve retaining all 42 unmapped /tournament/* routes with zero invented redirects until semantic successors exist?
ownerDecisions.recommendedLabel: Retain all 42; no redirects; writer hygiene only where links already have a tournamentId and a proven same-workflow target

rejectedOptions.label: Redirect hubs/setup to Engine tabs
rejectedOptions.reason: Semantic mapping unproven; would break daily/internal/official/team/register/public/director flows

rejectedOptions.label: Invent or guess tournamentId for hub redirects

ownerDecisions.consequence: Phase 4 implements no B02 redirects. Legacy mounts remain for compatibility. Flag ON menu/search continue excluding /tournament/*.
ownerDecisions.risk: Legacy deep links and flag-OFF writers remain until a later incremental migration program.
ownerDecisions.implementationImpact: Docs matrix only for redirects; optional replace_link_writer for Engine breadcrumb/back away from legacy /tournament after OD-PLURAL approved.

ownerDecisions.plainLanguageQuestion: Who may open /player/skill-assessment-v5 by direct URL: SUPER_ADMIN only (Phase 1 B03 text), or enrolled PLAYER pilots under the V5 product contract?
ownerDecisions.recommendedLabel: Hide from all menus/search; allow authenticated SUPER_ADMIN always for tech eval; allow PLAYER only when VITE_PICK_VN_RATING_V5_ENABLED + active pilot enrollment; deny all others with 403; flag alone never exposes menu

rejectedOptions.label: Router SUPER_ADMIN-only for all direct access
rejectedOptions.reason: Conflicts with V5 foundation PLAYER self-assessment pilot RPCs and existing page access service

rejectedOptions.label: Authenticated-only route + PLAYER menu when flag on
rejectedOptions.reason: Violates B03 hide-shadow menu rule and over-exposes via legacy menu writers

ownerDecisions.consequence: Revises B03 direct-access wording from SUPER_ADMIN-only to pilot-aligned shadow. Menu/search remain hidden in every shell.
ownerDecisions.risk: If Owner insists on strict SUPER_ADMIN-only, Rating V5 pilot UX breaks until a separate PLAYER entry is provided.
ownerDecisions.implementationImpact: Change authGuard/menuAccess/navigationConfig (remove PLAYER menu leaf); keep page-level resolveRatingV5Access; add denial tests; no redirect.

ownerDecisions.plainLanguageQuestion: Should /tournaments/:tournamentId/* Engine routes require authentication and tournament permissions at least as strong as legacy /tournament/* before Preview flag ON?
ownerDecisions.recommendedLabel: Remove plural routes from public-auth prefix descendants; require auth; route-level permission tournament.update (matching page gate) or documented split; add tenant/club ownership check before engine load

rejectedOptions.label: Keep /tournaments/* public-auth
rejectedOptions.reason: Weaker than legacy; exposes engine deep links when auth production enabled

rejectedOptions.label: Only require tournament.view
rejectedOptions.reason: Weaker than current page PermissionGate tournament.update for mutating tabs

ownerDecisions.consequence: Closes Preview blocker BLK-PLURAL-AUTHZ. Public catalog /tournaments (list) remains public; parameterized Engine family becomes protected.
ownerDecisions.risk: Deep links that previously worked anonymously will require login — intentional hardening.
ownerDecisions.implementationImpact: authGuard.js PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES refinement; menuAccess.js plural matcher; optional ownership assert in useTournamentEngine/RouteAccessGate; tests in phase4-tournament-authz.
